# Dhruv Singh — Full-Stack Developer & Computer Engineering

> Dhruv Singh is a Full-Stack Developer and Computer Engineering student at Toronto Metropolitan University (TMU) based in Toronto, Canada, building web applications, AI products, embedded systems, and hardware.

## Summary
Full-stack software developer and computer engineering student with a track record of building web applications, AI-integrated software, embedded systems, and digital hardware architectures. Currently serving as Co-op Program Assistant at the TMU Career, Co-op & Student Success Centre.

## Key Projects
- [Brainstormzz](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): AI-powered whiteboard application for structured concept generation using OpenAI API, HTML5 Canvas, and React.
- [Urban Carpool Matching System](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): Geospatial ride-sharing matching engine in Python processing 500+ simulated rider coordinates with optimal pickup clusters.
- [Rover Arm Controller & CV Test Automation](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): Robotics test framework using Python, OpenCV, and Arduino to automate precision verification across 6 servo joints with ARUCO tag visual feedback.
- [8-Bit General-Purpose Processor](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): Custom processor architecture designed in VHDL with ALU, multi-state control FSM, registers, and decoders validated on Intel Quartus and ModelSim.
- [Bookstore Application](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): Desktop retail management software implemented in Java Swing using State and Factory design patterns with persistent customer tiers.
- [Three-Stage MOSFET Voltage Amplifier](https://dhruvsingh.dev/projects): 180nm CMOS multi-stage analog amplifier designed and simulated in KiCad and ngspice achieving 42 dB voltage gain and >1.8 MHz bandwidth.

## Core Technical Skills
- Languages: Python, Java, C, C#, JavaScript, SQL, VHDL.
- Frontend & Web: React, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Responsive UI/UX, Component State Machines.
- Backend & Databases: Node.js, Express, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Relational DBMS.
- Hardware & Systems: FPGA (Quartus & ModelSim), Arduino, Digital Circuits & FSM Design, Analog IC Design (CMOS).
- AI / ML & Tools: OpenAI API, OpenCV, Git, GitHub, Jira, Excel (VLOOKUP & Data Auditing).
